description_en: Call ResizeDbfs to resize a DBFS (database file system)
description_zh: 调用ResizeDbfs扩容一个数据库文件系统
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs resize-dbfs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --fs-id dbfs-GOrr00000000Yd0VLOyBpg --new-size-g 40 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResizeDbfs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database file system
parameters.name: fs_id

parameters.help_en: The capacity of the database file system after resizing. It must be greater than its capacity before resizing. Unit: GiB
parameters.help_zh: 扩容后的数据库文件系统容量，必须大于扩容前的数据库文件系统容量。单位GiB
parameters.name: new_size_g
